author: JOHN_CENAAAAAAAA
body:
I was banned off of TeamSpeak, as shown:


Was my temp-ban or ban really false?
Easily. I was banned for racism when there is no evidence other than the testimony of the "victim" (who is known to be a pain towards me.) with my side never heard. Toxic behavior? Really? Compared to other users of TS and the forums, I'm the nicest guy in the world. Disrespect is pathetic. Before you even consider punishing someone for "disrespect" you need to respect your own community. This is why everybody is leaving. Wake up! Stop being dickheads to the community and solve problems with talks instead of punishments like these! And abuse of ranks? I'm retired and Emerald, I don't know what I can abuse buddy.

Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false?
Yep! You have none to show that it's true!

Where is evidence not needed? Especially with PERM bans? 

Have I waited long enough to be un-banned?
False bans shouldn't happen in the first place.

Have I been caught ban evading?
No.

Have I appealed a ban before?
I appealed them all the time when I was an Admin.

Just please, PLEASE get your staff to be able to handle situations properly in TeamSpeak. If you know me, you know that I can be a troll. But I know that I don't break the rules. I'm sick and tired of staff targeting me, especially Flo and Steven going insane with punishments.

Also, I'd like a staff who isn't biased against me to answer this. A lot of staff are much against me because I'm simply not afraid to stand up to you, hence why I got banned. I'd like for you to read and appeal me because you looked at the facts objectively.

replies.body:
I don't know about instances of the first few ("Very excessive racism, toxic behavior") but the last surely constitutes a ban. You abused earlier privileges as an Admin to grant yourself a new/special rank. There are many accounts of this, staff and players alike were bothered and issues remain due to those actions.

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
Moderators are people, they can be a victim of peer-pressure or they might just be having a bad day like any normal person. They are going to make mistakes, but if they break a rule, well that is usually inexcusable. In that case we depend on first hand accounts to take action on the individual. We want to know if "they're enforcing rules that they don't follow" because it's bad for the server and players.

You're right that I am seeing this from a different perspective but I can't begin to see how in any situation we could simply brush off racism, trolling and other poor behavior that you have been a part of.
